The API accepts `'fine-tune'`, `'batch'`, and `'ocr'` — `purpose="ocr"` is correct and documented [1].

The `purpose` enum for the Upload File endpoint is explicitly:

> `purpose` (enum: 'fine-tune', 'batch', 'ocr', optional) [1]

So your type checker's SDK definitions are just out of date/incomplete — likely an older version of the `mistralai` Python package that hasn't caught up with the `ocr` purpose. Update the SDK to the latest version, or if you're vendoring/pinning types, regenerate/upgrade them.

Note there's also a `speech` context floating around some SDK betas, but per current docs the canonical set is `fine-tune | batch | ocr`.

- [Files API — Upload File](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/files#operation-files_api_routes_upload_file)
